The '''Parmel sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], near the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]]. Some [[Planet/Legends|planets]] contained in the sector included [[Vohai]], [[Aris V]], [[Kallistas]] and [[Turcan III]].

The sector was the location of the [[Parmel Sector Stock Exchange]].

==History==
The Parmel sector was governed at different times by [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] [[Raiss]] and [[Tallis]]. [[Churhee's Riflemen]], a mercenary company formerly allied to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and later to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], was active in this sector.

Before [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] gambler [[Cunbus Locb]] visited several planets in this area, earned an amount of money and left onboard his ship, ''[[Distant Wind]]'', to the chagrin of several fleeced locals.<ref name="stock">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Parmel sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
